title: Advise Maritime that a customer has died
summary: You can request that Maritime update a customer's records to show that they have died by visiting a service centre or posting a request to the Service NSW Agency Business Centre.
intro: You can request that Maritime update a customer's records to show that they have died by visiting a service centre or posting a request to the Service NSW Agency Business Centre.
what_you_need: One of the following pieces of documentation confirming the deceased's status

how_to_steps.text: Make sure that you have your proof of identity, and one of the required documents.
